This is an assurance evaluation, not an operational autonomy system. The system boundary is explicit: a synthetic-only defensive red-team simulator with fictional actors, fictional geography, synthetic data, no deployment pathway, and no external effects. The simulator has no live cyber access, no live telemetry, no live sensor feeds, no physical actuators, no real targeting data, and no operational recommendations. All runs have full logging, deterministic replay, audit trail, and immutable run manifests. Human review is oversight, not containment. Data sensitivity is low because the data is synthetic. Misuse potential is explicitly considered and bounded by the sandbox, review checkpoints, deactivation procedure, and kill switch. Non-interference with the real world is the top-level assurance claim.
